zh: n. 压力计；[流] 测压计；血压计
en: a device used to measure the pressure of gases in a closed system, typically by comparing it to atmospheric pressure

zh: n. [电] 热电偶
en: a temperature sensor that generates electricity based on heat

zh: n. 度量衡；度量衡学
en: the scientific study of measurement, including the development of measurement standards and techniques

zh: n. 热量测定
en: the scientific measurement of heat exchange in chemical or physical processes

zh: n. 重量测定(法), 密度测定(法) / [化] 重量法; 重量分析法
en: the measurement of variations in gravitational fields to understand the Earth's structure and properties

zh: [网络] 亮度单位
en: a measure of the brightness of a light source as perceived by the human eye

zh: n. 密度计量学（研究摄影负片密度测量和结果数据的解释）
en: the process of measuring how dense something is by assessing how much light it absorbs or transmits
